sources.title: BiCC: Bidirectional Connected-Component Loss for Instance-Aware Segmentation
sources.read_scope: Official abstract, introduction, method section 2, experimental setup and evaluation definitions.
sources.finding: Reference and prediction component partitions, including explicit false-positive scoring, already address instance recall/precision. Not a remote-sensing reproduction.
sources.uncompleted: No author-code commit pinning, installation, training or numerical reproduction.

sources.title: blob loss: instance imbalance aware loss functions for semantic segmentation
sources.finding: Instance imbalance and instance-sensitive segmentation losses predate this candidate.
sources.uncompleted: Full paper and code not examined in this batch.

sources.title: Object-Level Contrastive-Learning-Based Multi-Branch Network for Building Change Detection from Bi-Temporal Remote Sensing Images
sources.read_scope: Publisher-indexed abstract and section 3.3 text; direct full page returned 429.
sources.finding: Object-level contrastive optimization and auxiliary semantic features are established CD design elements.
sources.uncompleted: Full paper, code and protocol not verified.

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Noisy Label Learning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
sources.read_scope: Publisher-indexed abstract; direct page required JavaScript verification.
sources.finding: Noisy-label correction, edge refinement and uncertainty-based robust supervision have direct CD neighbours.
sources.uncompleted: No full text, author-code verification or reproduction.

sources.title: Remote Sensing Change Detection via Weak Temporal Supervision
sources.read_scope: Official abstract, introduction, related work and dataset section 3.1.
sources.finding: Single-date semantic labels plus new temporal acquisitions, real/artificial pairing and iterative refinement are already studied.
sources.uncompleted: Full training implementation and code not verified; required data not locally admitted.

sources.title: Feature Spectrum Learning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
sources.read_scope: CVF-indexed abstract and introduction; HTML returned 403.
sources.finding: Learnable feature-spectrum alignment is an existing pseudo-change approach; not proposed for implementation here.
sources.uncompleted: No complete method/code or dataset adaptation.

sources.title: ValaisCD dataset card
sources.read_scope: Label provenance, temporal discrepancy, pruning, split, released unpruned data and citation sections.
sources.finding: Vector/image timing discrepancies are acknowledged. Paper uses a pruned collection; this project uses the unpruned release. No new label error is thereby established.
sources.uncompleted: No unsafe pickle parsing, independent relabeling, noise-rate estimate or spatial-ID reconstruction.

claim_boundary: No novelty certification, paper reproduction, scientific performance comparison or external code execution.
